newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: EVA Air mulls Oct rates hike but JAL stays firm.
newsitem.headline: EVA Air mulls Oct rates hike but JAL stays firm.

text.p: EVA Air is considering ex-Europe rates increases from October, said Hans Lin, EVA European general manager.
The Taiwanese carrier will probably increase rates on all destinations from Europe by between five and ten percent, following the general trend, he said.
Market activity from the Netherlands to Taiwan is especially busy at the moment, he added, with most of the flights experiencing full loads.
Meanwhile, Japan Airlines, is one carrier that is not considering Autumn increases - from the Netherlands at least.
A spokesman for the Japanese airline said that the rate is already at a fairly healthy level and in line with the market conditions.
However, competitors operating from the Netherlands would probably increase rates to bring their rates up and more in line with JAL's own, he added.
JAL's rates for seasonal products such as flower bulbs and vegetables have already been fixed to March 1998, he said.
Rates for general cargo may be reviewed in January next year but for this year they have already been fixed, he said. - Reuters Air Cargo Service Tel+ 44 171 542 7706 Fax +5017 - www.racs.com
